# WebCrawler.buzz — Web Crawler Online Free (Full Documentation)

> A free web crawler online and domain crawler online tool to crawl any website online and generate a comprehensive SEO audit report.
> Website: https://webcrawler.buzz | Also known as: DomainCrawler, WebCrawler, Online WebCrawler

## Product Overview

WebCrawler.buzz (DomainCrawler) is a web crawler online free tool built for SEO professionals, developers, and website owners who want to crawl website online quickly and for free. This domain crawler online and URL crawler tool performs breadth-first search (BFS) crawling scoped to a root domain and extracts detailed page-level data.

No registration is required. No API key is needed. Just paste a URL, click "Start Crawl," and use this website crawler online free to view your results. It's the best web crawl online tool available — a true free web crawler online with no limitations.

## How It Works

1. **Submit a URL** — Enter any website URL on the homepage
2. **Duplicate Detection** — If the domain was already crawled, you can view existing results or start a fresh re-crawl
3. **BFS Crawling** — The crawler visits every discoverable page on the domain using breadth-first search, staying within the root domain scope
4. **Real-Time Progress** — Watch a live progress bar with percentage updates (polls every 5 seconds)
5. **Tracking URL** — Get a shareable bookmark link to check progress or results anytime
6. **Email Notification** — Optionally enter your email to get notified when the crawl completes
7. **View Results** — Browse a paginated table with all crawled pages and SEO data
8. **Export CSV** — Export your full results as a CSV file, delivered via email

## Data Extracted Per Page

For every page crawled, Domain Crawler collects:

| Field | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| URL | The full URL of the crawled page |
| Page Title | The content of the `<title>` tag |
| Meta Description | The content of the `<meta name="description">` tag |
| HTTP Status Code | The HTTP response status (200, 301, 404, 500, etc.) |
| Response Time | Time to receive the response in milliseconds |
| Content Type | The MIME type of the response (text/html, application/json, etc.) |
| Page Size | The size of the response body in bytes |
| Internal Links Count | Number of links pointing to pages on the same domain |
| External Links Count | Number of links pointing to other domains |
| Redirect URL | If the page redirected, the final destination URL |
| Indexable | Whether the page is indexable by search engines |
| Discovered At | Timestamp when the page was first discovered |

## Features in Detail

### Free & No Registration
This domain crawler online is completely free. No account creation, no API keys, no usage limits on the number of pages crawled per domain. It’s the best free website crawler and web crawler tool free available online. Also works as a crawler free alternative to paid desktop tools.

### Real-Time Progress Tracking
After starting a crawl with this web crawler online, you see a live progress bar that updates every 5 seconds showing how many pages have been crawled out of the total discovered.

### Shareable Tracking URLs
Each crawl generates a unique tracking URL that you can bookmark or share. Come back anytime to check progress or view results, even after closing the browser. Perfect for crawling online across devices.

### Duplicate Domain Detection
If you try to crawl a domain that was already crawled, this online website crawler shows you the existing results count and gives you two options:
- **View Existing Results** — Jump straight to the previous crawl data
- **Re-crawl Fresh** — Start a completely new crawl of the domain

### Email Notifications
During a crawl, an email notification card slides in after a few seconds. Enter your email address to receive a notification when the crawl completes, including a direct link to your results.

### Paginated Results
Results are displayed in a clean, sortable table with pagination. Choose to view 50, 100, 500, or 1000 results per page.

### CSV Export
Click the "Export CSV" button, enter your email, and receive a download link within minutes. The CSV contains all crawled page data. Download links are valid for 5 minutes.

## Technical Architecture

- **Backend**: Express.js v5 with TypeScript (strict mode)
- **Database**: Neon PostgreSQL with SSL
- **Queue System**: BullMQ with Redis for job processing
- **Crawling**: axios for HTTP requests + cheerio for HTML parsing
- **Email**: Nodemailer with Gmail SMTP
- **Frontend**: Static HTML with Tailwind CSS and vanilla JavaScript

### Concurrency & Rate Limiting
- Crawler queue concurrency: 5 simultaneous crawl jobs
- CSV export queue concurrency: 2 simultaneous exports
- API rate limit: 200 POST requests per 15-minute window per IP
- GET requests are exempt from rate limiting

## API Endpoints

Domain Crawler exposes the following REST API endpoints:

### Start a Crawl
```
POST /api/crawl
Body: { "url": "https://example.com" }
Response: { "job_id": "uuid", "tracking_url": "/results?job_id=uuid" }
```

### Handle Duplicate Domain Decision
```
POST /api/crawl/decide
Body: { "domain": "example.com", "action": "re-crawl" | "use-existing" }
```

### Get Crawl Progress
```
GET /api/crawl/:jobId/progress
Response: { "status": "running", "progress_percent": 45, "total_pages_found": 23, "total_pages_queued": 51 }
```

### Get Crawl Results (Paginated)
```
GET /api/crawl/:jobId?page=1&limit=50
Response: { "domain": "example.com", "status": "completed", "pages": [...], "pagination": {...} }
```

### Register Email Notification
```
POST /api/crawl/:jobId/notify
Body: { "email": "user@example.com" }
```

### Request CSV Export
```
POST /api/crawl/:jobId/export
Body: { "email": "user@example.com" }
```

### Check Export Status
```
GET /api/crawl/:jobId/export/status
Response: { "active": true, "status": "processing", "email": "user@example.com" }
```

### Download Exported CSV
```
GET /api/crawl/:jobId/export/download/:exportId
Response: CSV file download (valid for 5 minutes after generation)
```

## Database Schema

### crawl_jobs
Stores metadata about each crawl job.
- id (UUID, primary key)
- url (TEXT) — the submitted URL
- domain (TEXT) — extracted root domain
- status (TEXT) — pending, running, completed, failed
- total_pages_found (INTEGER)
- total_pages_queued (INTEGER)
- email (TEXT, nullable) — notification email
- created_at (TIMESTAMP)
- updated_at (TIMESTAMP)

### crawled_pages
Stores data for each crawled page.
- id (SERIAL, primary key)
- job_id (UUID, foreign key → crawl_jobs.id)
- url (TEXT)
- page_title (TEXT)
- meta_description (TEXT)
- status_code (INTEGER)
- response_time_ms (INTEGER)
- content_type (TEXT)
- page_size_bytes (INTEGER)
- internal_links_count (INTEGER)
- external_links_count (INTEGER)
- redirect_url (TEXT)
- is_indexable (BOOLEAN)
- discovered_at (TIMESTAMP)

### csv_exports
Tracks CSV export requests and their lifecycle.
- id (UUID, primary key)
- job_id (UUID, foreign key → crawl_jobs.id)
- email (TEXT)
- status (TEXT) — processing, completed, expired
- file_path (TEXT)
- created_at (TIMESTAMP)
- expires_at (TIMESTAMP)

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: Is Domain Crawler really free?**
A: Yes, completely free with no hidden costs, no registration required, and no limits on the number of pages crawled. It’s the best website crawler online free tool available. WebCrawler.buzz is a free web crawler, free site crawler, and free online web crawler all in one.

**Q: How long does a crawl take?**
A: It depends on the size of the website. Small sites (under 100 pages) typically complete in under a minute. Larger sites may take several minutes. You can bookmark the tracking URL and come back later. Use web crawler test mode for quick checks.

**Q: Can I crawl any website?**
A: You can crawl a website online as long as it’s publicly accessible. This online web crawler and URL crawler respects the domain boundary and only crawls pages within the root domain you submit. You can also test crawl a website to verify your setup.

**Q: What’s the difference between this and other crawlers?**
A: Unlike desktop tools, this is a website crawler free online — no downloads needed. It works as an online webcrawler, site crawler online, and free online crawler from any browser. Crawl site online instantly.

**Q: How do I export my results?**
A: Click the "Export CSV" button on the results page, enter your email, and you'll receive a download link within minutes.

**Q: How long are export files available?**
A: CSV download links are valid for 5 minutes after generation. After that, you can request a new export.

**Q: Can I crawl a website I don't own?**
A: Domain Crawler accesses only publicly available pages, similar to how Google's crawler works. However, please use the tool responsibly and only crawl sites you have permission to analyze.

## Trust & Transparency

WebCrawler.buzz is a fully open-source project built by Hasibul Islam (https://github.com/devhasibulislam). Key trust signals:

- MIT License — 100% of the source code is public on GitHub
- Featured on Product Hunt (https://www.producthunt.com/products/webcrawler-buzz)
- No data retention — crawl results auto-delete after 1 hour, CSV exports after 5 minutes
- Security: Helmet HTTP headers, CORS, rate limiting (200 POST req/15 min), parameterized SQL queries
- Standard health check endpoint at /api/health (database + Redis connectivity)
- Public usage statistics endpoint at /api/stats
- security.txt at /.well-known/security.txt for responsible vulnerability disclosure
- SECURITY.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md, CHANGELOG.md in the repository
- Tech stack: Node.js v20+, TypeScript (strict mode), Express.js v5, PostgreSQL (Neon serverless), Redis + BullMQ, Axios, Cheerio, Nodemailer
